summary: DRDGOLD Limited filed a Form 6-K furnishing the results of its annual general meeting held 6 November 2026, pursuant to a notice dated 30 September 2026. All ordinary and special resolutions passed by the requisite majority, including auditor appointment (BDO South Africa, Jacques Barradas), director re-elections and elections, audit and social/ethics committee memberships, remuneration policy and implementation report, and a general authority to repurchase issued securities. Roughly 89.4% of shares were represented. This is a routine meeting-results disclosure, mapped to a US annual meeting outcome announcement, with no transaction, stake, price, premium, or board recommendation on a deal; no risk-arb angle applies.
